note: Level 1 section 1 (dining room) played from start to exit without taking damage. Found by a savestate search, no cheats. Reach the level with START on NES frames 1000, 1100, 1200 (menus) and 1300 (skips the night scene and cutscene); hold nothing until frame 1700; then apply 'inputs' as [buttons, frames] runs. Buttons are libretro ids as in emu.py (0 B, 6 LEFT, 7 RIGHT, 8 A). The player walks off the right edge of the 8th screen on the last run; the screen then fades out and the kitchen section starts.
